_doc: Wave 3 tier C fill (2026-11-25): road swords, the contract house, the outer gate and the hall of sleeves.

people.role: Road sword, Khúc Liệt Dương's second on the western roads
people.backstory: Rode twenty years behind Khúc Liệt Dương (khuc_liet_duong) on the western roads and came home with her; he holds that no one should seal a long hire who has not ridden one, and this year he has refused two hires Lam Khế Ngôn (lam_khe_ngon) sealed until she lets him read the contracts, and lost both fees.
people.changed: fixB-apply 2026-11-25: no longer a rival with words only (read-pilot-B); he refuses unread hires and pays for it

ties.note: the clerk who seals hires she has never ridden

tree.intent: Metal sword; one finishing cut, then gone.

people.backstory: Bought out of a camel-train debt at fourteen by Lam Khế Ngôn (lam_khe_ngon), she pays both the southern company's wages and the sleeve price to the families of the dead, and keeps a stone in ten of every sleeve price. Her wage book puts the nine southern dead on the Tower's iron road, and she charges Lam more for her silence each time.

ties.note: bought her out at fourteen; now pays her for silence by the sleeve
the sweeper asking which road her brother died on

people.changed: fix pass B 2026-11-25: Diligent, Loyal -> Greedy, Callous (she skims the sleeve price and charges Lam for silence); tie to lam_khe_ngon now creditor; tie to yen_lac_tu added. fixB-apply: her way of knowing restored (she pays the southern wages too, so she keeps both books)

people.role: Outer disciple from the plateau mine, who came with Lộ Khinh Trần
people.backstory: Came down from Tập Trận Khoáng with Lộ Khinh Trần (lo_khinh_tran) on the head's mule in 1195 because the two boys would not be parted; the head tested him for Wind on the road and found none, and he has not forgiven the wind. Since the winter of 1199 he holds the lamp at the hall door while the head opens the founder's robe for Lộ.

ties.note: from the same mine; he holds the lamp for the robe

tree.intent: Metal sword on an Earth root.

people.role: Outer disciple from the hot steppe, one contract sealed
people.backstory: From Đinh Hỏa Lân's (dinh_hoa_lan) village of Thập Giáp; she sealed her first contract, a salt train, in a short sleeve, and means to ride on Khúc Liệt Dương's (khuc_liet_duong) next long hire whatever the contract house says.

tree.intent: Fire sword for the noon road.

people.role: Inner disciple at Can Tương Khoáng, who carries the ore to Thối Tinh Môn
people.backstory: Âu Dương Kiên's (au_duong_kien) son, who carries Can Tương ore up to Thối Tinh Môn each autumn and brings the blades back; he has fallen for the polisher Đàm Kính Nguyệt (dam_kinh_nguyet) and carries more ore than anyone asked for.

people.role: Inner disciple of the contract house, who presses the Seal
people.backstory: Lam Khế Ngôn's (lam_khe_ngon) inner disciple, who presses the Seal on what she is handed and asks nothing; she wants Giang Bích Sa's (giang_bich_sa) copying desk, and has offered Lam to copy the contract house's road book for half Giang's fee.
people.changed: fixB-apply 2026-11-25: 'has noticed' (a noticer) -> an offer that undercuts Giang

ties.note: the copying desk; offered to do it for half her fee

people.role: Outer disciple who sweeps the hall of sleeves
people.backstory: Sweeps the hall of sleeves; the newest is her brother's. He broke the taboo to write her one letter from an iron town on the southern road, yet the valley says he died on a camel road. She is spending his sleeve price, their mother's money, on wine for the Đà Đội drivers at the valley mouth. Thôi Ấn Thư (thoi_an_thu) told her to stop.
people.changed: fixB-apply 2026-11-25: the sleeve's smell (a noticer) -> her brother's letter as her way of knowing; she pays, with her mother's sleeve price; drivers asked at the valley mouth (Đà Đội is 38 days off)

ties.note: the paymaster who tells her to stop asking
